_setup_notes: Tools are standalone objects in ElevenLabs (POST https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/convai/tools), not embedded in agent JSON - see docs/API_SETUP_GUIDE.md section 2. Replace {{N8N_WEBHOOK_BASE_URL}} with your n8n base URL. After creating each tool, note its returned 'id' (tool_xxxx) - you'll need it for tool_ids in the agent JSON files.

tool_config.name: verify_employee
tool_config.description: Look up an employee by employee_id or email to confirm they are a real employee before discussing their account.

email.description: Work email, used if employee_id is not given

tool_config.name: create_ticket
tool_config.description: Log an IT billing or technical issue that needs a real change made, or a human to finish resolving.

tool_config.name: escalate_to_human
tool_config.description: Hand the call off to a live human IT support agent and get back a reference number.

reason.description: Why the call is being escalated

ticket_id.description: ticket_id from create_ticket, if one exists
